title: X622 XApp API 2.1 through 2.15 fixed-memory profile

required_imports.description: SDK build gate only: imports that must survive final WASM linking. Not part of the device package header.

required_exports.description: SDK build gate only: lifecycle callbacks that must survive final WASM linking.

zh.description: At most 47 UTF-8 bytes; glyph subset embedded automatically.

icon.description: Square PNG path relative to app.json; converted offline to native 32x32 RGB565+A8.

font.description: Licensed TTF/TTC/OTF path relative to app.json. Required for non-ASCII names; converted at native 20 px, 4 bpp.

name.description: 1..47 UTF-8 bytes; byte length is checked by the packager.

version.description: 1..15 UTF-8 bytes; byte length is checked by the packager.

permissions.description: Public permission mask 0x3F7F; ESPNOW (8192) requires API 2.6 and <=48 KiB linear memory. AUDIO_CAPTURE (1024) requires API 2.7. Unknown bits and import/permission mismatches are rejected by release validation.

linear_memory.description: WAMR host heap, not physical linear memory. Bare C profile requires zero.
